label: A bearer is numerically identified by all its nonempty-path ancestors
paraphrase: Open criterion of numerical identity on one selected graph. For every x and y, agreement on all z that reach them by a nonempty directed path implies x = y. This ranges over all bearers, including dependents. A nonempty path can return to its starting point in a cyclic graph. Interpreting the paths as precisely the full existential ancestry of actual concrete beings remains open.
